responsibility: Provides the Arm target hooks used by the GCC D front end. It publishes D version identifiers that reflect Thumb and floating-point ABI configuration and registers target-info query handlers such as the floatAbi string returned by __traits(getTargetInfo), translating Arm backend option state into D frontend target metadata.
same_name_distinction: Contains the actual D frontend target-hook implementations for Arm, translating backend option state into D version identifiers and target-info strings, while arm-d.h merely declares those entry points and maps the target-hook macros to them.
